description: This 64 GB micro SDXC UHS-I U3 Class 10 memory card delivers fast and reliable performance for a wide range of portable devices—from smartphones and tablets to action cameras and handheld consoles. With transfer speeds of up to 70 MB/s read and 30 MB/s write, it's ideal for Full HD and 4K video recording, high-speed continuous burst photos, and smooth app operation. Built with high-quality flash memory, it also offers lower power consumption for extended battery life. Rugged and versatile, it includes an SD adapter for compatibility with standard card slots.
